serverInfo.name: sagargohil.dev
serverInfo.description: MCP server for Sagar Gohil's portfolio — exposes tools and resources for querying projects, skills, experience, and contact.

tools.name: get_projects
tools.description: Returns the list of projects Sagar has worked on, including title, description, tech stack, and link.

tools.name: get_skills
tools.description: Returns Sagar's technical skills grouped by category.

tools.name: contact
tools.description: Sends a contact/hire inquiry to Sagar. Requires name, email, phone, service, and message.

resources.name: Portfolio (Markdown)
resources.description: Full portfolio content as Markdown — projects, skills, experience, and education.

resources.name: API Catalog
resources.description: RFC 9727 API catalog listing available API endpoints.
